summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 30-question PPI with auto-save functionality. All P0 and P1 features verified working correctly.

P0_PPI_AutoSave.details: Auto-save endpoint /api/ppi/autosave works correctly. Saves answers after each selection. Tested single answer, multiple answers, and upsert behavior.

P0_PPI_Draft_Restore.details: Draft endpoint /api/ppi/draft returns saved progress. UI shows 'You have saved progress!' message and 'Continue Where I Left Off' button. Restores to correct question index.

P0_PPI_30_Questions.details: PPI endpoint returns exactly 30 questions. Progress shows '1 / 30' through '30 / 30'. total_questions field is 30.

P0_PPI_Submit_Flow.details: Full 30-question submission generates Financial DNA, 24-trait vector, and LPI plan. UID is generated. Answers saved to ppi_answers collection.

P1_Likert_Scale_UI.details: Likert questions (Q1, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, Q10, Q12, Q13, Q15, Q18, Q21, Q24, Q27, Q28) show 'Rate 1-5' indicator with 5 buttons (1-5). Labels: Strongly Disagree to Strongly Agree.

P1_MCQ_UI.details: MCQ questions (Q2, Q4, Q6, Q9, Q11, Q14, Q16, Q17, Q19, Q20, Q22, Q23, Q25, Q26, Q29, Q30) show 'Choose one' indicator with A/B/C/D options.

P1_VIA_Trait_Labels.details: Each question shows VIA trait label (e.g., Creativity, Curiosity, Judgment). Trait vector computed with 24 traits.
